source.author: stat
source.text: Argolici, quibus haec datur hostia, manes, pandite Tartareum chaos ultricesque parate Eumenidas, venit ecce Creon!
source.text_original: 'Argolici, quibus haec datur hostia, manes, / pandite Tartareum chaos ultricesque parate / Eumenidas, venit ecce Creon!
source.text_english: Argive shades, to whom this victim is given, open up Tartarean chaos and prepare the avenging Eumenides: look, Creon is coming!

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tu, nuntia sontum virgo Iovi, terras oculis quae prospicis aequis, ultricesque deae Fasque et grandaeva Furorum poena parens, meritis regis succedite tectis et saevas inferte faces.
reuse.text_original: tu, nuntia sontum / virgo Iovi, terras oculis quae prospicis aequis, / ultricesque deae Fasque et grandaeva Furorum / poena parens, meritis regis succedite tectis / et saevas inferte faces.
reuse.text_english: You, maiden, report the guilty to Jupiter; you who look out over the earth with impartial eyes, and you avenging goddesses and the Fates, and ancient mother of the punishment of the Furies, take possession of the king’s house as he deserves, and bring in your cruel torches.
